verdict.rationale: Intercom's developer docs, which also host the Fin Agent API, document webhooks for subscribing to real-time event notifications such as Contact created and incoming Conversation received, so a programmatic consumer can receive outbound HTTP callbacks. The listed events are general Intercom helpdesk events, though, and nothing shows Fin-specific events, so coverage of the story for Fin is only partial. missing for 10: Fin-specific webhook events (e.g. Fin resolution, escalation or procedure events), documentation of subscription registration, payload signing and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to subscribe to real-time notifications of events happening in Intercom; a Contact created, an incoming Conversation received, or an Outbound Message receipt.
